name: Fjärdlång
description: Sparse-service Fjärdlång island loop from the public ferry quay. The route uses gravel road, narrow SAT-marked paths, technical coastal/cliff terrain, forest/ridge trail, meadows, bays and the island high point Tysta Klint. Current official SAT guidance says hikers must be self-sufficient: no water during 2026, limited services, and the hostel temporarily closed.
waterSources: SAT step guide says no water during 2026; hikers must bring their own. Do not promote hostel/cafe/camping/guest-harbor water claims unless a later current operator or official source confirms public drinking-water access.
notes: Route shape: counter-clockwise loop from Fjärdlång public ferry quay.
Fjärdlång research object is an isolated draft. Do not import automatically into app data.
Iteration 1 uses current SAT values 11.7 km, Moderate, 3.5 hours and 79 m elevation gain, while preserving official PDF/Outdooractive/export conflicts around 11.4 km and 4:00 h.
Current SAT guidance says no water during 2026 and hostel temporarily closed; this suppresses older service evidence for water, food, cafe, shop and lodging.
Dry toilets are the only normal facility candidates in iteration 1; all access, rules, emergency, lodging, rentals, harbors and boating services stay guarded metadata.

Iteration 2 proximity QA found Vedviken toilet candidates about 180-342 m from the official KML line, so Vedviken should be treated as an official side-facility/detour candidate rather than a directly on-route toilet.
Iteration 2 added coordinates for Tysta Klint and Thielska Villan, but kept swimming as a natural context anchored near Sopbryggan rather than an exact managed bathing facility.
Iteration 3 promotes Thielska Villan as a normal heritage POI candidate with a route-side spur caveat, and keeps swimming secondary because no exact managed bathing-place coordinate was found.
Iteration 3 import QA moved the southern tenting/camping area into pendingOnlyUntilVerifiedRecords so guarded campsite metadata is not mistaken for a normal facility candidate.

Iteration 4 found USF/Vitsgarn public-service plans for summer 2026, but no current public hiker booking/opening/water terms strong enough to override SAT's no-water and bring-food/accommodation warnings.

Iteration 5 promotes Noret/Långhuset to a normal toilet candidate, keeps Klubbhamn/southwest pending-only, and preserves all water, hostel/cafe/kiosk/shop, campsite-service, rental, firepit, waste and boating suppressions.
